Title: Public preview update: Azure Automation supports PowerShell 7.2 and Python 3.10 runbooks

Body.Content:
Azure Automation has expanded Public preview support for PowerShell 7.2 and Python 3.10 runbooks in almost all Public regions except Australia Central2, Korea South, Sweden South, Jio India Central, Brazil SouthEast, Central India, West India, UAE Central and Gov clouds. These new runtimes are now supported for both Cloud and Hybrid jobs. 

Azure Portal experience to author and execute runbooks remains the same as previously available Runtime versions. PowerShell 7.2 and Python 3.10 can be easily selected through the dropdown menu during runbook creation.

Learn more about PowerShell 7.2 and Python 3.10 runbooks and Execution of Hybrid jobs on new runtime versions.

Try the new features and share your experience at askazureautomation@microsoft.com
